articles.title_en: Voluntary participation in a negotiation on providing public goods and renegotiation opportunities
articles.title_cn: 公共物品供给谈判中的自愿参与与重新谈判机会
articles.abstract_en: We examine the problem of voluntary participation in negotiations regarding the provision of public goods. In contrast to earlier studies, in our model, a negotiation is followed by renegotiations. First, players decide whether to participate in a negotiation, and the participants produce a public good. The participants then renegotiate the level of the public good with nonparticipants in the preceding negotiations. We show that with these renegotiation opportunities, many players may participate in providing the public good in the preceding negotiation. In some cases, all players participate in the preceding negotiation and the public good is produced efficiently. Our findings indicate that more players participate in the provision of public goods if they have strong bargaining power in the renegotiations. Hence, this problem may not be as severe as reported by previous studies. Our results may be consistent with the recent developments in voluntary projects for international river management.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了公共物品供给谈判中自愿参与的问题。与早期研究不同，在我们的模型中，谈判之后会进行重新谈判。首先，参与者决定是否参与谈判，参与者生产公共物品。然后，参与者与先前谈判中的非参与者就公共物品的水平进行重新谈判。我们表明，有了这些重新谈判的机会，许多参与者可能会参与先前谈判中的公共物品供给。在某些情况下，所有参与者都参与先前谈判，并且公共物品被有效生产。我们的研究结果表明，如果参与者在重新谈判中拥有较强的议价能力，那么会有更多的参与者参与公共物品的供给。因此，这个问题可能不像先前研究报告的那样严重。我们的结果可能与国际河流管理自愿项目的最新发展相一致。

articles.title_en: ‘Relabelling’ of individual early retirement pension in Finland: Application and behavioural responses using Finnish register data
articles.title_cn: 芬兰个人提前退休养老金的“重新标签”：基于芬兰登记数据的申请与行为反应
articles.abstract_en: Using rich Finnish population level registers, we examine the impact of fusing a flexible early retirement pathway with a more stringent pathway, without changing eligibility conditions, so-called ‘relabelling’, on individual application behaviour. Our findings show that among affected cohorts the likelihood of applying for (successfully claiming) disability-related early retirement declined by 1.8 (1.5) percentage points equivalent to a relative drop of approximately 37 % (39 %) following the reform. Individuals with below tertiary level education and stronger lifetime labour market attachment exhibit a stronger behavioural response to the reform. We find tentative evidence of individual's bringing forward the age at which they substitute to a competing early retirement pathway designed to keep individuals in the labour market albeit on a part time basis. Our findings highlight the importance of targeted awareness building aimed at particular socioeconomic groups such as those with low levels of education when policymakers seek to consolidate early retirement programmes with differing pre-reform eligibility criteria.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用丰富的芬兰人口层面登记数据，我们考察了将灵活的提前退休路径与更严格的路径合并（不改变资格条件，即所谓的“重新标签”）对个人申请行为的影响。我们的研究结果显示，在受影响的队列中，申请（成功申领）与残疾相关的提前退休的可能性在改革后下降了1.8（1.5）个百分点，相当于相对下降约37%（39%）。受教育程度低于高等教育水平且终身劳动力市场依附性较强的个体对改革表现出更强的行为反应。我们发现了初步证据表明，个人会提前转向一种旨在让个体留在劳动力市场（尽管是兼职）的竞争性提前退休路径的年龄。我们的研究结果强调了在政策制定者整合具有不同改革前资格标准的提前退休计划时，针对特定社会经济群体（如低教育水平群体）进行有针对性的意识提升的重要性。

articles.title_en: To plan, or not to plan? Optimal planning and saving for retirement
articles.title_cn: 规划，还是不规划？退休的最优规划与储蓄
articles.abstract_en: A large percentage of U.S. households arrive at retirement with little or no financial wealth. Empirical evidence suggests that many of these households undertook little or no planning for retirement while young. We demonstrate how the decision to avoid planning and saving for retirement while young can arise as an optimal choice made by forward-looking, utility maximizing households facing an exogenous retirement date. In our model, boundedly rational households select the length of their planning horizon optimally each period, in addition to making an optimal consumption and saving decision. Planning is costly insofar as households must expend effort, cognitive or otherwise, to plan for the future. In a calibrated version of our model, the average household avoids planning and saving for retirement while young and, as a result, arrives at retirement with less than one-fifth of the wealth that they otherwise would have accumulated had they instead planned for their entire remaining lifetime, as in a standard life-cycle model.
articles.abstract_cn: 美国有很大比例的家庭在退休时几乎没有或根本没有金融财富。经验证据表明，这些家庭中有许多在年轻时很少或根本没有为退休进行规划。我们证明了在面临外生退休日期的前瞻性、效用最大化家庭中，年轻时避免规划和储蓄退休的决定如何可以作为最优选择出现。在我们的模型中，有限理性的家庭每期最优地选择其规划视野的长度，同时做出最优的消费和储蓄决策。规划是有成本的，因为家庭必须花费努力（认知或其他方面）来规划未来。在我们模型的校准版本中，平均家庭在年轻时避免规划和储蓄退休，结果在退休时积累的财富不到如果他们像标准生命周期模型那样为整个剩余寿命进行规划所能积累财富的五分之一。

articles.title_en: Parental and Student Time Use Around the Academic Year
articles.title_cn: 家长与学生在学年期间的时间使用
articles.abstract_en: We demonstrate how mothers, fathers, and 15–17-year-old students alter their schedules around the K-12 academic year. Using regression discontinuity methods, combined with school start and end dates, we show that mothers are more affected by the school year than are fathers. During the school year, mothers sleep less, spend more time caring for others, and have less time for eating, free time, and exercise. Fathers experience fewer and mostly smaller changes. Teenagers reduce education time by 5.5 hours per day on weekdays during the summer, substituting that time with 2+ hours of free time and 1+ hours of sleep.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们展示了母亲、父亲和15-17岁学生如何围绕K-12学年调整他们的日程。使用断点回归方法，结合学校开学和结束日期，我们表明母亲比父亲更受学年影响。在学年期间，母亲睡眠减少，花更多时间照顾他人，而用于吃饭、自由时间和锻炼的时间减少。父亲经历的变化较少且大多较小。青少年在夏季工作日每天减少5.5小时的教育时间，用2小时以上的自由时间和1小时以上的睡眠来替代。

articles.title_en: Targeted policies and household consumption dynamics: Evidence from high-frequency transaction data
articles.title_cn: 定向政策与家庭消费动态：来自高频交易数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: The COVID-19 pandemic shock heavily affected households and prompted governments to design policies supporting household consumption. Differentiated strategies were among the most commonly adopted policies, targeting territories and economic activities with a stringency consistent with the severity of the contagion. Leveraging a unique dataset of over 1 billion household payment transactions, which captures digital and physical consumption, we provide a retrospective analysis of targeted restrictions in Italy during the fall of 2020. We show that territories implementing less stringent policies exhibit a smaller reduction in consumption and that differentiated restrictions are effective in limiting the spread of infections. Furthermore, in our analyses we account for common factors limiting household consumption choices such as disposable income, liquidity constraints and fear of contagion. Our results demonstrate the effectiveness of targeted restrictions in balancing between economic and public health objectives and call for data-driven and evidence-based policymaking during crises.
articles.abstract_cn: COVID-19疫情冲击严重影响了家庭，并促使政府设计支持家庭消费的政策。差异化策略是最常采用的政策之一，针对地区和经济活动，其严格程度与传染严重程度一致。利用超过1亿笔家庭支付交易的独特数据集，该数据集涵盖了数字和实体消费，我们对2020年秋季意大利的定向限制措施进行了回顾性分析。我们表明，实施较不严格政策的地区消费减少较小，且差异化限制在限制感染传播方面是有效的。此外，在我们的分析中，我们考虑了限制家庭消费选择的常见因素，如可支配收入、流动性约束和感染恐惧。我们的结果证明了定向限制在平衡经济和公共卫生目标方面的有效性，并呼吁在危机期间进行数据驱动和基于证据的政策制定。

articles.title_en: Does retirement make people more risk averse?
articles.title_cn: 退休是否使人更加风险厌恶？
articles.abstract_en: We investigate whether retirement makes people more risk averse. Using a nationally representative household survey dataset from urban China, we adopt a local randomization regression discontinuity design to estimate the causal effect of retirement on risk attitudes. We find that males become more risk averse after they have retired while females do not; consistently, households tend to participate less in the stock market and invest a lower fraction of financial assets in stocks when their male heads retire but exhibit no such patterns when female heads retire. Therefore, the impact of retirement on risk attitudes exhibits significant gender heterogeneity. Pathway analyses suggest that the decrease in risk taking is largely driven by the decline in income flow after retirement.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究退休是否使人更加风险厌恶。利用中国城市具有全国代表性的家庭调查数据集，我们采用局部随机化断点回归设计来估计退休对风险态度的因果效应。我们发现男性在退休后变得更加风险厌恶，而女性则不然；一致地，当家庭中的男性户主退休时，家庭倾向于减少股市参与，并将较低比例的金融资产投资于股票，而当女性户主退休时则没有这种模式。因此，退休对风险态度的影响表现出显著的性别异质性。路径分析表明，风险承担减少在很大程度上是由退休后收入流的下降所驱动的。

articles.title_en: Credit constraints and delayed entrepreneurship
articles.title_cn: 信贷约束与延迟创业
articles.abstract_en: How much do financial constraints delay entrepreneurship and how much do they cost households in terms of foregone welfare in countries with large informal sectors and poorly developed financial markets? This paper uses a standard, partial equilibrium, dynamic model of occupational choice under financial constraints to derive the optimal time that households take to switch from subsistence work to entrepreneurship. Using data from the informal sector in Cameroon, the paper first tests the implications of the model with reduced-form, survival regression models and then structurally estimates key parameters using maximum likelihood. Prospective entrepreneurs would need to work for an average of 7 years as subsisters to accumulate the minimum savings required to start their micro-enterprise. Among the potential entrepreneurs about 53% are subsisters implying a missing proportion of entrepreneurs of 10.9% among which more than 32% have wealth below their estimated poverty traps. This means that despite their talent and ability to save a sizable fraction of the population will never start a profitable firm, given the tight collateral constraints in the economy. Finally, the paper conducts counterfactual simulations based on the estimated model. The results show substantial welfare gains from relaxing credit constraints, accruing mostly to high talent individuals.
articles.abstract_cn: 在拥有大量非正规部门和金融市场发展不完善的国家，金融约束在多大程度上延迟了创业，又通过放弃的福利给家庭带来了多少成本？本文使用一个标准的、局部均衡的、在金融约束下的职业选择动态模型，推导出家庭从 subsistence 工作转向创业所需的最优时间。利用喀麦隆非正规部门的数据，本文首先用简化形式的生存回归模型检验了模型的含义，然后使用最大似然法对关键参数进行结构化估计。潜在的创业者平均需要作为 subsistence 工作者工作 7 年，才能积累起创办微型企业所需的最低储蓄。在潜在创业者中，约有 53% 是 subsistence 工作者，这意味着创业者缺失比例为 10.9%，其中超过 32% 的人的财富低于其估计的贫困陷阱。这意味着，尽管他们有才能和储蓄能力，但由于经济中严格的抵押品约束，相当大比例的人口永远不会创办盈利的企业。最后，本文基于估计的模型进行了反事实模拟。结果表明，放松信贷约束会带来可观的福利收益，这些收益主要归于高才能个体。

articles.title_en: War, international spillovers, and adolescents: Evidence from Russia's invasion of Ukraine in 2022
articles.title_cn: 战争、国际溢出效应与青少年：来自2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰的证据
articles.abstract_en: Using novel longitudinal data, this paper studies the short- and medium-term effects of Russia's invasion of Ukraine on February 24, 2022 on social trust of adolescents in Germany. Comparing adolescents who responded to our survey shortly before the start of the war with those who responded shortly after the conflict began and applying difference-in-differences (DiD) models over time, we find a significant decline in the outcome after the war started. These findings provide new evidence on how armed conflicts influence social trust and well-being among young people in a country not directly involved in the war.
articles.abstract_cn: 利用新颖的纵向数据，本文研究了2022年二月24日俄罗斯入侵乌克兰对德国青少年社会信任的短期和中期影响。通过比较在战争开始前不久和冲突开始后不久回答我们调查的青少年，并应用随时间变化的双重差分（DiD）模型，我们发现战争开始后结果显著下降。这些发现为武装冲突如何影响未直接卷入战争国家的年轻人的社会信任和福祉提供了新的证据。

articles.title_en: Kantian imperatives in public goods networks
articles.title_cn: 公共品网络中的康德式律令
articles.abstract_en: To maximize aggregate effort, a principal allocates agents to a given graph of roles where each agent’s reward is exogenously fixed and increases in the aggregate effort of their immediate neighbourhood. Effort is costly for individual agents, thus forming a local public goods game. Agents can be selfish or stubborn (following Kantian imperatives that maximize agent welfare). For regular graphs, we provide conditions under which Kantians are located in clusters or are far apart. When Kantian and isolated-selfish efforts are close, the principal’s optimal allocation also maximizes agent welfare. We discuss difficulties surrounding the notion of Kantian imperatives on non-regular graphs and solve the principal’s problem on graphs where roles are entirely based on degree. Our results show that, compared to standard public goods games over complete networks, organizations with Kantian agents suffer from both over- and under-provision of public goods when the underlying graph becomes relevant.
articles.abstract_cn: 为了最大化总努力水平，委托人将代理人分配到给定的角色图中，其中每个代理人的报酬是外生固定的，并随着其直接邻域的总努力增加而增加。努力对个体代理人而言是有成本的，从而形成一种局部公共品博弈。代理人可以是自私的或固执的（遵循最大化代理人福利的康德式律令）。对于正则图，我们提供了康德主义者聚集或分散的条件。当康德式努力与孤立的自私努力接近时，委托人的最优配置也最大化代理人福利。我们讨论了在非正则图上康德式律令概念的困难，并在角色完全基于度的图上解决了委托人的问题。我们的结果表明，与完全网络上的标准公共品博弈相比，当底层图变得相关时，具有康德主义代理人的组织会遭受公共品的过度供给和供给不足。

articles.title_en: Does health affect attitudes towards immigration?
articles.title_cn: 健康是否影响对移民的态度？
articles.abstract_en: Can poor health lead to more negative attitudes towards immigration? Using data from the German Socio-Economic Panel (1999–2021) and the European Social Survey (2002–2021), I find that poorer subjective health, disability, as well as longstanding physical and mental health conditions, are strong predictors of anti-immigration sentiment. The instrumental variable results, where an individual's health is predicted with the health of other household members, supports the causal nature of this relationship. To understand what is driving the results, I explore the role of health-induced changes in 1) perceptions of immigrants’ use of public services, 2) subjective wellbeing and 3) contact with health professionals. Overall, this study is the first to highlight health as an important determinant of attitudes toward immigration, and it suggests that health improvements can lead to more open and tolerant societies.
articles.abstract_cn: 健康状况不佳是否会导致对移民的态度更加消极？利用德国社会经济面板数据（1999-2021年）和欧洲社会调查数据（2002-2021年），我发现较差的自我评估健康、残疾以及长期的身体和心理健康状况是反移民情绪的有力预测因素。工具变量结果（其中个体的健康状况由其他家庭成员的健康状况预测）支持了这种关系的因果性质。为了理解驱动结果的因素，我探讨了健康引起的变化在1）对移民使用公共服务的看法、2）主观幸福感以及3）与卫生专业人员接触方面的作用。总体而言，本研究首次强调健康是影响移民态度的重要决定因素，并表明健康改善可以带来更加开放和宽容的社会。

articles.title_en: The impact of mortgage broker use on borrower confusion and preferences
articles.title_cn: 抵押贷款经纪人使用对借款人困惑与偏好的影响
articles.abstract_en: We examine how mortgage brokers affect borrower confusion about key mortgage features and assess whether brokers mitigate confusion by educating borrowers. Drawing from two lab-in-the-field experiments, we first show a correlation between the attributes borrowers find most confusing and those they find least important. Second, we show that borrowers who secure loans directly from lenders demonstrate lower confusion levels compared to those using brokers, even after accounting for self-selection bias. Despite this, broker users exhibit higher decision satisfaction and confidence after taking a loan. Third, using responses from discrete choice experiments to implement a causal mediation analysis with a single IV, we evaluate the influence of broker use, financial literacy, and subjective confusion on borrowers’ willingness to pay for specific mortgage attributes. Our findings reveal that broker users are willing to pay more for attributes that increase the value and duration of loans, increasing broker commissions.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了抵押贷款经纪人如何影响借款人对关键抵押贷款特征的困惑，并评估经纪人是否通过教育借款人减轻困惑。基于两项实地实验室实验，我们首先展示了借款人认为最令人困惑的属性与他们认为最不重要的属性之间的相关性。其次，我们表明，即使考虑了自选择偏差，直接从贷款机构获得贷款的借款人的困惑水平也低于使用经纪人的借款人。尽管如此，经纪人用户在贷款后表现出更高的决策满意度和信心。第三，利用离散选择实验的响应，实施带有单一工具变量的因果中介分析，我们评估了经纪人使用、金融素养和主观困惑对借款人为特定抵押贷款属性支付意愿的影响。我们的研究结果显示，经纪人用户愿意为增加贷款价值和期限的属性支付更多，从而增加经纪人佣金。

articles.title_en: Effort, talent, and inequality in a small open economy
articles.title_cn: 小型开放经济中的努力、才能与不平等
articles.abstract_en: We develop a general equilibrium model of a small open economy with performance-pay worker compensation and occupational choice. We analytically and numerically examine the distributional effects of entrepreneurial talent and performance-pay contracts. Risk-neutral, more talented individuals become entrepreneurs, inducing workers to exert effort through incentive contracts. Entrepreneurial talent and worker effort significantly influence income inequality through complex general equilibrium channels. Economies with higher tariffs, more entrepreneurs, less skilled or more heterogeneous workers, and economies without worker effort, display higher income inequality measured by the top one percent income share and the Gini Coefficient.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们构建了一个小型开放经济的一般均衡模型，其中包含绩效工资工人补偿和职业选择。我们通过解析和数值方法考察了创业才能和绩效工资合同的分配效应。风险中性、更有才能的个人成为企业家，通过激励合同促使工人付出努力。创业才能和工人努力通过复杂的一般均衡渠道显著影响收入不平等。关税较高、企业家较多、工人技能较低或异质性较强，以及没有工人努力的经济体，其以最顶层百分之一收入份额和基尼系数衡量的收入不平等程度更高。

articles.title_en: On the effectiveness of leading by example in public goods games
articles.title_cn: 论公共品博弈中以身作则的有效性
articles.abstract_en: Despite the growing interest in leadership in the experimental literature, theoretical analyses of leadership have received relatively limited attention. This study investigates the effectiveness of leading by example in public goods games among reciprocal agents. The “leading-by-example” game (LBE) is a two-stage game with the same payoff structure as the classic voluntary contribution mechanism (VCM), in which a leader first makes a contribution decision, followed by the followers who make a contribution decision upon observing the leader’s move. If the marginal per capita return (MPCR) is sufficiently high, LBE is more effective than VCM at inducing contributions. However, if MPCR is low, VCM is more effective than LBE. An experimental test of the comparative statics is conducted.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管实验文献中对领导力的兴趣日益增长，但关于领导力的理论分析受到的关注相对有限。本研究探讨了在互惠主体间的公共品博弈中，以身作则的有效性。“以身作则”博弈（LBE）是一个两阶段博弈，其收益结构与经典的自愿贡献机制（VCM）相同，其中领导者首先做出贡献决策，随后追随者在观察到领导者的行动后做出贡献决策。如果边际人均回报（MPCR）足够高，LBE在诱导贡献方面比VCM更有效。然而，如果MPCR较低，VCM比LBE更有效。本文进行了比较静态分析的实验检验。

articles.title_en: Poverty spells and economic freedom: Canadian evidence
articles.title_cn: 贫困持续期与经济自由：加拿大证据
articles.abstract_en: Economic freedom is generally associated with higher average income levels, but does it benefit the very poor as well? Does it help them to escape their disadvantaged position? Does it reduce the probability of falling into low-income status? This paper deals with those questions using longitudinal data from Canada regarding the duration of low income spells, as well as entries and exits from low-income status from 1992 to 2020. Aggregated at the provincial level and inside a panel regression approach, these different indicators of low-income status are negatively related (i.e., less poverty) with the Fraser Institute’s Economic Freedom of North America (EFNA) index.
articles.abstract_cn: 经济自由通常与较高的平均收入水平相关，但它是否也使最贫困者受益？它是否帮助他们摆脱不利地位？它是否降低了陷入低收入状态的概率？本文利用加拿大关于低收入持续期以及1992年至2020年低收入状态进入和退出的纵向数据来探讨这些问题。在省级层面汇总并在面板回归方法内，这些低收入状态的不同指标与弗雷泽研究所的北美经济自由（EFNA）指数呈负相关（即贫困减少）。

articles.title_en: Resource, competition, and the equilibrium effects of innovation subsidies
articles.title_cn: 资源、竞争与创新补贴的均衡效应
articles.abstract_en: We study the equilibrium effects of innovation subsidies that reduce firms’ innovation costs in a monopolistic competition model with firm heterogeneity in innovation capabilities and an industry-level resource constraint. Subsidies change product market competition and resource price, and further affect firms’ innovation. We show a counterintuitive result: though subsidies lower innovation costs, high-capability firms may reduce their innovation. This finding implies that the demand curve for innovation investments of certain firms in equilibrium can be locally upward-sloping. We show that at the industry level, both average innovation input and output demonstrate inverted-U-shaped responses to increasing subsidies, with differing turning points. Notably, an increase in average innovation input may be accompanied by a decrease in average innovation output. These findings cast doubts on the interpretation of existing empirical evidences on firm and industry responses to innovation subsidies, most of which assume away treatment effect heterogeneity and equilibrium feedbacks.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在具有企业创新能力异质性和行业层面资源约束的垄断竞争模型中，降低企业创新成本的创新补贴的均衡效应。补贴改变了产品市场竞争和资源价格，并进一步影响企业的创新。我们展示了一个反直觉的结果：尽管补贴降低了创新成本，高能力企业可能会减少其创新。这一发现意味着，在均衡中，某些企业的创新投资需求曲线在局部可以是向上倾斜的。我们表明，在行业层面，平均创新投入和产出对增加的补贴均呈现倒U型响应，且转折点不同。值得注意的是，平均创新投入的增加可能伴随着平均创新产出的减少。这些发现对现有关于企业和行业对创新补贴响应的经验证据的解释提出了质疑，其中大多数假设了处理效应异质性和均衡反馈的缺失。

articles.title_en: Modeling sacrifice
articles.title_cn: 牺牲建模
articles.abstract_en: Recent evidence suggests that a person’s reciprocity toward others depends on the amount of sacrifice made by others. We develop a reciprocity model that incorporates the concept of sacrifice, defined as the payoff forgone when choosing an action. Our model retains many desirable properties of the existing reciprocity models, while capturing the nuanced psychology of reciprocity. In our model, one’s motivation to reciprocate increases in the size of others’ sacrifice. In two-person games, it can be shown that our model strengthens reciprocity motivation in reciprocity equilibria that are not Nash equilibria under selfish preferences.
articles.abstract_cn: 近期证据表明，一个人对他人的互惠性取决于他人所做的牺牲量。我们开发了一个互惠模型，该模型融入了牺牲的概念，牺牲被定义为选择某个行动时放弃的收益。我们的模型保留了现有互惠模型的许多理想性质，同时捕捉了互惠的微妙心理。在我们的模型中，一个人的互惠动机随着他人牺牲的大小而增加。在两人博弈中，可以证明我们的模型在非自私偏好下的纳什均衡的互惠均衡中增强了互惠动机。

articles.title_en: Survey expectations and adjustments for multiple testing
articles.title_cn: 调查预期与多重检验的调整
articles.abstract_en: Testing hypotheses regarding how individual survey respondents form their expectations is susceptible to the multiple testing problem. The probability of falsely rejecting the null hypothesis for one or more respondents will exceed the nominal single-hypothesis significance level. The Bonferroni correction and related approaches control the family-wise error rate, but are conservative and result in low power when the null hypotheses are false.
articles.abstract_cn: 关于个体调查受访者如何形成预期的假设检验容易受到多重检验问题的影响。对一个或多个受访者错误拒绝原假设的概率将超过名义上的单一假设显著性水平。Bonferroni校正及相关方法控制了族系错误率，但在原假设为假时较为保守且功效较低。

articles.title_en: The strategic use of social identity
articles.title_cn: 社会认同的策略性使用
articles.abstract_en: Individuals often have the power to manipulate which of their multiple dimensions of social identity are salient when entering economic interactions. This paper represents the first empirical exploration of this phenomenon. Experimental results show identity dimension choice is of substantial importance, providing potential earnings gains up to around 56%. Actual gains are smaller: people choose identity dimensions strategically and benefit from broadly accurate beliefs about counterparts’ discriminatory tendencies, but are also hampered by some misperceptions (e.g. overestimating levels of in-group favouritism). Furthermore, many individuals sacrifice expected payoffs to make their preferred dimensions salient, suggesting intrinsic utility derives from social identity.
articles.abstract_cn: 个体在进入经济互动时，往往有能力操纵其多重社会认同维度中哪些维度变得显著。本文是对这一现象的首次实证探索。实验结果表明，认同维度的选择具有实质性重要性，潜在收益增幅可达约56%。实际收益较小：人们策略性地选择认同维度，并受益于对对手歧视倾向的广泛准确信念，但也受到一些误解（例如高估内群体偏袒程度）的阻碍。此外，许多个体牺牲预期收益以使其偏好的维度变得显著，这表明社会认同具有内在效用。

articles.title_en: The political economy of public housing upgrading programs
articles.title_cn: 公共住房升级项目的政治经济学
articles.abstract_en: This paper finds new evidence of using public housing upgrading programs for political rent-seeking motives. We merged datasets comprising public housing upgrading programs, resale public housing transactions, electoral division boundaries, and general election events in Singapore from 2010 to 2016. We find evidence of significant increases in public housing upgrading programs in the ruling party constituencies one quarter before general elections. Due to resource constraints, the probability of blocks being selected for future upgrading programs diminishes with the upgrading announcements in neighboring housing blocks. The negative externality is felt more by residents of affected housing blocks in the opposition constituencies, causing price declines of 1.9 % more than housing blocks in the ruling party constituencies. The preferential treatment in the upgrading program selection process for the ruling party constituencies over the opposition constituencies widens the housing price gap between the two constituencies.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文发现了利用公共住房升级项目进行政治寻租动机的新证据。我们合并了包含公共住房升级项目、转售公共住房交易、选举分区边界以及新加坡2010年至2016年大选事件的数据集。我们发现，在大选前一个季度，执政党选区的公共住房升级项目显著增加的证据。由于资源限制，邻近住房区块的升级公告会降低未来区块被选入升级项目的概率。这种负外部性在反对党选区的受影响住房区块居民中感受更为强烈，导致其价格比执政党选区的住房区块多下降1.9%。执政党选区在升级项目选择过程中相对于反对党选区的优惠待遇，扩大了两个选区之间的住房价格差距。

articles.title_en: House purchase restriction and stock market participation: Unveiling the role of nonpecuniary consideration
articles.title_cn: 限购政策与股市参与：揭示非货币考量的作用
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates how house purchase restriction (HPR) affects stock market participation among households in China. Using a staggered difference-in-differences (DID), we observe a decrease in household stock market participation following the adoption of the HPR policy in a city. HPR decreases stock market participation by 1.72 percentage points and households' net equity purchase and equity to total wealth ratio by 17% and 0.2 percentage points, respectively. These findings suggest that house and stock investments cannot substitute each other. Furthermore, our analysis reveals that the negative effect of HPR is not driven by pecuniary consideration (house price and income risks) but rather by nonpecuniary consideration (risk aversion). Although the HPR policy is designed to curb the surge in local house prices, it reduces household's demand for equity investing, which creates a negative externality on the financial market.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了住房限购政策（HPR）如何影响中国家庭的股市参与。采用交错双重差分法（DID），我们观察到城市实施HPR政策后，家庭股市参与率下降。HPR使股市参与率下降1.72个百分点，家庭净股权购买和股权占总财富比率分别下降17%和0.2个百分点。这些发现表明，住房和股票投资不能相互替代。此外，我们的分析揭示，HPR的负面效应并非由货币考量（房价和收入风险）驱动，而是由非货币考量（风险厌恶）驱动。尽管HPR政策旨在抑制当地房价的飙升，但它降低了家庭对股权投资的需求，这对金融市场产生了负外部性。

articles.title_en: Historical roots of loneliness and its impact on second-generation immigrants’ health
articles.title_cn: 孤独的历史根源及其对第二代移民健康的影响
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the relationship between historical cultural norms and attitudes towards loneliness, specifically within the context of second-generation immigrants. We uncover an intergenerationally transmitted cultural element that emphasizes restraint and adherence to strict rules characterizing highly-intensive pre-industrial agricultural systems. This cultural dimension significantly impacts how individuals perceive their social relationships and influences their likelihood of experiencing loneliness. Additionally, we demonstrate that the identified cultural trait serves as a predictor of loneliness in a two-stage model for health. Our research shows that loneliness directly impacts body mass index and specific mental health issues, and these findings hold true across a battery of sensitivity checks. The results add to the existing body of research highlighting the importance of attitudes in predicting economic and health outcomes, shedding light on how deeply ingrained geographical, cultural, and individual characteristics can shape economic development processes in both home and host countries.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了历史文化规范与对孤独的态度之间的关系，特别是在第二代移民的背景下。我们发现了一种代际传递的文化元素，该元素强调克制和遵守严格规则，这些规则是高度密集的前工业化农业系统的特征。这一文化维度显著影响个体如何感知其社会关系，并影响其经历孤独的可能性。此外，我们证明所识别的文化特征在健康的两阶段模型中可作为孤独的预测因子。我们的研究表明，孤独直接影响身体质量指数和特定的心理健康问题，并且这些发现在一系列敏感性检验中均成立。研究结果补充了现有研究，强调了态度在预测经济和健康结果中的重要性，揭示了根深蒂固的地理、文化和个体特征如何塑造母国和东道国的经济发展过程。

articles.title_en: The mixed effects of innovation strategies and bribery on firm performance: A Re-investigation via institutional quality
articles.title_cn: 创新战略与贿赂对企业绩效的混合效应：基于制度质量的再研究
articles.abstract_en: While a large body of literature has explored the impacts of bribery on firm performance, particularly in terms of innovation outcomes, a significant gap exists in understanding the effects of innovation strategies on firms’ performance as well as the influence of institutional quality on the interaction between innovation strategies and bribery. This paper empirically addresses this gap by investigating the complex effects of bribing and two distinct innovation strategies—independent innovation and spillover innovation. Using global firm-level evidence from the latest Business Environment and Enterprise Performance Survey, we employ three semiparametric methods to estimate productivity as proxy of firms’ performance. Our results show that independent innovation exerts sanding influences on productivity, while spillover innovation and bribery grease the wheels of firm performance. Moreover, bribery and spillover innovation mutually amplify each other's positive effects on firm performance. Further examinations indicate that the impacts of innovation strategies and bribing are significantly moderated by institutional quality. Under poor institutional quality with excessive government control or corruption, the positive influence of spillover innovation and bribing tends to be strengthened. Conversely, good institutional quality mitigates the greasing effects of spillover innovation and bribery. Through multiple robustness tests employing alternative methodologies, firm performance metrics, and institutional quality measures, these findings are consistently confirmed.
articles.abstract_cn: 尽管大量文献探讨了贿赂对企业绩效的影响，特别是在创新成果方面，但在理解创新战略对企业绩效的影响以及制度质量对创新战略与贿赂之间相互作用的影响方面，仍存在显著空白。本文通过调查贿赂和两种不同的创新战略——独立创新和溢出创新——的复杂效应，实证地填补了这一空白。利用最新商业环境和企业绩效调查的全球企业层面证据，我们采用三种半参数方法来估计作为企业绩效代理变量的生产率。我们的结果表明，独立创新对生产率产生阻碍作用，而溢出创新和贿赂则对企业绩效起到润滑作用。此外，贿赂和溢出创新相互放大彼此对企业绩效的积极影响。进一步的研究表明，创新战略和贿赂的影响受到制度质量的显著调节。在政府控制过度或腐败严重的低制度质量下，溢出创新和贿赂的积极影响趋于增强。相反，良好的制度质量会削弱溢出创新和贿赂的润滑效应。通过采用替代方法、企业绩效指标和制度质量衡量标准的多种稳健性检验，这些发现得到了一致确认。

articles.title_en: Uncertainty and macroeconomic forecasts: Evidence from survey data
articles.title_cn: 不确定性与宏观经济预测：来自调查数据的证据
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the effects of macroeconomic and financial uncertainty on professional economic forecasts. Using the predictions of four variables sourced from the Bloomberg survey, we find that macroeconomic uncertainty, a proxy for the complexity of the forecasting task, is associated with high disagreement and low accuracy. By contrast, the results show that financial uncertainty is associated with low disagreement and high accuracy, which suggests that financial uncertainty encourages forecasters to adhere to the consensus to avoid large forecast errors. Furthermore, we find that the forecaster rank moderates the effect of macroeconomic uncertainty, indicating that high-ability forecasters can better navigate periods of high uncertainty. This study advances the understanding of forecasting behavior under uncertainty.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了宏观经济和金融不确定性对专业经济预测的影响。利用来自彭博调查的四个变量的预测，我们发现宏观经济不确定性（预测任务复杂性的代理指标）与高分歧和低准确性相关。相比之下，结果显示金融不确定性与低分歧和高准确性相关，这表明金融不确定性促使预测者遵循共识以避免大的预测误差。此外，我们发现预测者排名调节了宏观经济不确定性的影响，表明高能力预测者能更好地应对高不确定性时期。本研究增进了对不确定性下预测行为的理解。

articles.title_en: Vaccination as personal public-good provision
articles.title_cn: 作为个人公共品供给的疫苗接种
articles.abstract_en: Vaccination against infectious diseases has both private and public benefits. We study whether social preferences – concerns for the well-being of other people – are associated with one’s decision regarding vaccination. We measure these social preferences for 549 online subjects with a public-good game and an altruism game. To the extent that one gets vaccinated out of concern for the health of others, contribution in the public-good game is analogous to an individual’s decision to obtain vaccination, while our altruism game provides a different measure of altruism, equity, and efficiency concerns. We proxy vaccine demand with how quickly a representative individual voluntarily took the initial vaccination for COVID-19 (after the vaccine was widely available). We collect COVID-19 vaccination history separately from the games to avoid experimenter-demand effects. We find a strong result: Contribution in the public-good game is associated with greater demand to voluntarily receive a first dose, and thus also to vaccinate earlier. Compared to a subject who contributes nothing, one who contributes the maximum ($4) is 58% more likely to obtain a first dose voluntarily in the four-month period that we study (April through August 2021). In short, people who are more pro-social are more likely to take a voluntary COVID-19 vaccination. Behavior in our altruism game does not predict vaccination. We recommend further research on the use of pro-social preferences to help motivate individuals to vaccinate for other transmissible diseases, such as the flu and HPV.
articles.abstract_cn: 针对传染病的疫苗接种既有私人收益也有公共收益。我们研究社会偏好——对他人福祉的关注——是否与个人的疫苗接种决策相关。我们通过公共品博弈和利他博弈测量了549名在线被试的社会偏好。就个人出于对他人健康的关注而接种疫苗而言，公共品博弈中的贡献类似于个人决定接种疫苗，而我们的利他博弈则提供了对利他、公平和效率关注的不同度量。我们用代表性个体在疫苗广泛可及后自愿接种COVID-19首剂疫苗的速度来代理疫苗需求。我们分别收集COVID-19疫苗接种史与博弈数据，以避免实验者需求效应。我们发现一个强有力的结果：公共品博弈中的贡献与自愿接种首剂疫苗的更高需求相关，因此也与更早接种相关。与贡献为零的被试相比，贡献最大（$4）的被试在我们研究的四个月期间（2021年四月至八月）自愿获得首剂疫苗的可能性高58%%。简言之，更亲社会的人更可能自愿接种COVID-19疫苗。我们在利他博弈中的行为不能预测疫苗接种。我们建议进一步研究利用亲社会偏好来激励个人接种其他传染性疾病疫苗，如流感和HPV。

articles.title_en: Unleashing the power of industrial robotics on firm productivity: Evidence from China
articles.title_cn: 释放工业机器人对企业生产力的影响：来自中国的证据
articles.abstract_en: This study investigates the effect of industrial robots on firm productivity in China. Employing propensity score matching (PSM) and staggered difference-in-difference (SDID) estimations, we find a statistically significant and positive casual effect of robot adoption on firm productivity at the 1 % significance level, leading to an approximate 10 % increase in total factor productivity (TFP) among manufacturing firms in China. The effect was most pronounced in the first two years following adoption but lost statistical significance from the third year onward. Additionally, we find that robot exposure, measured by both adoption rate and adoption intensity, had positive and statistically significant spillover effects on large-scale non-adopting firms within the same industry and city, leading to significant improvements in their TFP. Furthermore, the effect of robot adoption on firm productivity varied by robot type, firm size, and industry. Multi-functional robots (MFRs) exhibited a more substantial effect compared to singlefunctional robots (SFRs). The automotive, plastic/chemical, and metal industries had great productivity gains compared to other industries. These results withstand various rigorous robustness checks, reaffirming the validity and consistency of our findings.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究考察了工业机器人对中国企业生产力的影响。通过采用倾向得分匹配（PSM）和交错双重差分（SDID）估计，我们发现机器人采用对企业生产力在1%显著性水平上具有统计显著的正向因果效应，导致中国制造业企业的全要素生产率（TFP）大约提高10%。该效应在采用后的前两年最为显著，但从第三年起失去统计显著性。此外，我们发现机器人暴露（以采用率和采用强度衡量）对同一行业和城市内的大型非采用企业具有正向且统计显著的溢出效应，显著提升了其全要素生产率。进一步地，机器人采用对企业生产力的影响因机器人类型、企业规模和行业而异。多功能机器人（MFRs）相比单功能机器人（SFRs）表现出更显著的效果。汽车、塑料/化工和金属行业相比其他行业获得了更大的生产力提升。这些结果经受住了各种稳健性检验，重申了我们发现的有效性和一致性。

articles.title_en: Non-parametric tests of behavior in the commons
articles.title_cn: 公共资源中行为的非参数检验
articles.abstract_en: Commons problems present behavioral dilemmas, with tensions between individual and collective rationality. When users of a common-pool resource are not effectively excluded, the collective behavior of individuals pursuing their self-interests dissipates economic surplus. We derive a non-parametric test of whether individuals' collective behavior in resource extraction is consistent with the canonical commons model, namely Nash tragedy-of-the-commons behavior. Our approach allows for an arbitrarily concave, differentiable production function of total inputs and for heterogeneous agents with arbitrarily convex, differentiable costs of supplying inputs. We extend the test to allow for unobserved total output. We also define distance from the data to the model and develop statistical tests using the distance metric. Applying our approach to panel data of Norwegian commercial fishing vessels, we find the results of our test are consistent with the economic intuition that, in the absence of property rights, tragedy-of-the-commons behavior dissipates surplus. Significantly, we find property rights reforms move firms away from Nash tragedy-of-the-commons behavior.
articles.abstract_cn: 公共资源问题呈现行为困境，个人理性与集体理性之间存在张力。当公共池资源的用户未被有效排除时，追求自身利益的个体的集体行为会消散经济剩余。我们推导出一个非参数检验，用以判断个体在资源开采中的集体行为是否与经典公共资源模型（即纳什公地悲剧行为）一致。我们的方法允许总投入的生产函数为任意凹且可微，并允许异质性代理具有任意凸且可微的投入供给成本。我们将检验扩展至允许总产出不可观测的情况。我们还定义了数据到模型的距离，并利用该距离度量开发了统计检验。将我们的方法应用于挪威商业渔船的面板数据，我们发现检验结果与经济直觉一致，即在缺乏产权的情况下，公地悲剧行为会消散剩余。重要的是，我们发现产权制度改革使企业远离纳什公地悲剧行为。

articles.title_en: A modest basic income can benefit a poor majority
articles.title_cn: 适度的基本收入可以惠及贫困多数
articles.abstract_en: Given a general utility and income distribution and positive unemployment benefits, we analyze the impact of a universal basic income (UBI) financed by an income tax and reducing unemployment benefits. With extensive margins only and identical fixed costs of work, we show that UBI can benefit a poor majority. Plausible conditions can ensure similar results with different fixed costs. With both extensive and intensive margins but identical fixed costs, a modest UBI can still benefit a poor majority provided the income weighted tax elasticity of labor supply from intensive margins is less than the non-employment rate, which is usually true.
articles.abstract_cn: 给定一般效用和收入分配以及正的失业救济金，我们分析了由所得税资助并减少失业救济金的普遍基本收入（UBI）的影响。仅考虑广延边际且工作固定成本相同的情况下，我们表明UBI可以惠及贫困多数。合理的条件可以确保在固定成本不同的情况下得到类似结果。在同时考虑广延边际和集约边际但固定成本相同的情况下，适度的UBI仍然可以惠及贫困多数，前提是来自集约边际的劳动供给的收入加权税收弹性小于非就业率，这通常是成立的。

articles.title_en: Nudging for prompt tax penalty payment: Evidence from a field experiment in Indonesia
articles.title_cn: 助推及时缴纳税务罚款：来自印度尼西亚实地实验的证据
articles.abstract_en: We conduct a randomised controlled trial in Indonesia to evaluate the effect of three intervention letters on tax penalty compliance behaviour. Over 10,000 individual taxpayers are randomly assigned to receive either a deterrence, information, or simplification letter, or no letter. Our results indicate that simplification, which makes paying a penalty less burdensome administratively by providing billing codes to pay the penalties, yields the highest probability of timely settlement, increasing compliance by 32% compared to the control group. Deterrence also positively impacts penalty compliance, increasing timely settlement rates by 27%. The least effective intervention is the information letter. Although associated with a 10% increase in timely settlement, this effect is statistically insignificant at the 10% confidence level. Our results suggest that strategic messaging by tax authorities in developing countries can be a cost-effective tool for improving tax penalty payment compliance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们在印度尼西亚进行了一项随机对照试验，以评估三种干预信函对税务罚款合规行为的影响。超过10,000名个体纳税人被随机分配接受威慑信函、信息信函、简化信函或未收到任何信函。我们的结果表明，简化信函通过提供支付罚款的账单代码，在行政上减轻了支付罚款的负担，产生了最高的及时结算概率，与对照组相比，合规性提高了32%。威慑信函也对罚款合规产生积极影响，将及时结算率提高了27%。效果最弱的干预是信息信函。尽管与及时结算增加10%相关，但这一效果在10%置信水平下在统计上不显著。我们的结果表明，发展中国家税务机关的战略性信息传递可以成为改善税务罚款支付合规性的成本效益工具。

articles.title_en: Public goods and future audiences
articles.title_cn: 公共品与未来观众
articles.abstract_en: Individuals’ decisions to behave prosocially (or the contrary) can often be observed by other individuals, with no direct connection to them, but who may nevertheless be influenced by them (e.g. through social media). Does knowing that they may be viewed as role models by other, notably younger, people affect the way individuals behave? Does it make them more likely to behave prosocially? We study how participants’ behavior in an experimental public good game is affected when they know that information about their choices and outcomes, together with different sets of information about their identity, will be transmitted the following year to a set of new, unknown, first-year students at the same university. When subjects know their photo, choices and outcomes will be transmitted, they contribute significantly less. We explore different possible explanations and are able to rule out several. We argue that the most convincing are based on non-standard social image concerns (i.e. individuals are not trying to signal prosocial motivations).
articles.abstract_cn: 个体做出亲社会（或相反）行为的决定，往往可以被其他与之无直接联系但可能受其影响的个体观察到（例如通过社交媒体）。知道他们可能被其他人，尤其是年轻人视为榜样，是否会影响个体的行为方式？这是否会使他们更有可能做出亲社会行为？我们研究了当参与者知道关于其选择和结果的信息，连同关于其身份的不同信息集，将在下一年传递给同一所大学的一组新的、未知的一年级学生时，他们在实验性公共品博弈中的行为如何受到影响。当受试者知道他们的照片、选择和结果将被传递时，他们的贡献显著减少。我们探索了不同的可能解释，并能够排除若干种。我们认为最有说服力的解释基于非标准的社会形象关注（即个体并非试图传递亲社会动机）。

articles.title_en: Physical isolation and loneliness: Evidence from COVID lock-downs in Australia
articles.title_cn: 物理隔离与孤独感：来自澳大利亚COVID封锁的证据
articles.abstract_en: Loneliness contributes to mortality risk, comparable to the risks associated with smoking and obesity, although the causal determinants of loneliness remain less clear. This paper leverages mandatory stay-at-home orders in Australia as a natural experiment and employs data from a panel study to investigate the causal link between physical isolation and loneliness. By analyzing variations in the number of lockdown days experienced by respondents up until their interview dates, and utilizing difference-in-differences analyses with individual, region, and year fixed-effects estimations, we find, contrary to expectations, that the number of days in lockdown does not significantly impact loneliness. Our study examines cumulative, concurrent, and non-linear effects, and assesses external validity through community morale and peer effects during lockdowns using spatial analysis. Additionally, we delve into heterogeneous effects across various factors, such as income, age, personality, living arrangements, and remoteness, finding statistically and empirically insignificant effects. However, for extroverts and young people, we observe weak statistical significance. We investigate exclusion restrictions by analyzing factors including social contacts, internet access, job industry, and household characteristics in relation to loneliness; as well as time use and relationship satisfaction to better understand the underlying mechanism. Our study challenges the notion that 'being alone' and 'being lonely' are interchangeable concepts, providing the first empirical causal evidence of no links between the two. Furthermore, our findings refine earlier understandings of social isolation, highlighting that it likely encompasses factors beyond physical isolation.
articles.abstract_cn: 孤独感会增加死亡风险，其影响程度与吸烟和肥胖相关的风险相当，尽管孤独感的因果决定因素仍不太清楚。本文利用澳大利亚强制性居家令作为自然实验，并采用面板研究数据来探究物理隔离与孤独感之间的因果关系。通过分析受访者在访谈日期前经历的封锁天数的变化，并利用包含个体、地区和年份固定效应的双重差分分析，我们发现与预期相反，封锁天数对孤独感没有显著影响。我们的研究考察了累积效应、同期效应和非线性效应，并通过空间分析评估了封锁期间社区士气和同伴效应的外部有效性。此外，我们深入研究了收入、年龄、性格、居住安排和偏远程度等各种因素下的异质性效应，发现统计上和实证上均不显著。然而，对于外向者和年轻人，我们观察到微弱的统计显著性。我们通过分析社会接触、互联网接入、工作行业和家庭特征等因素与孤独感的关系来探究排除限制；以及时间使用和关系满意度，以更好地理解潜在机制。我们的研究挑战了“独处”和“孤独”是可互换概念的观点，提供了两者之间无关联的首个实证因果证据。此外，我们的发现完善了早期对社会隔离的理解，强调社会隔离可能包含物理隔离之外的因素。

articles.title_en: On generosity in public good and charitable dictator games
articles.title_cn: 论公共品与慈善独裁者博弈中的慷慨行为
articles.abstract_en: We examine the relationship between generosity in charitable dictator games (CDGs) and public good games (PGGs). We construct a novel generalized game that subsumes both as special cases and present experimental subjects with different blends of CDG and PGG tasks. Generosity in the CDG and PGG are only weakly correlated, in spite of close experimental control on confounding factors. We furthermore demonstrate how underlying preferences shape these behaviors, revealing important distinctions between preferences for charity and public good provision. Our findings have implications for the generalizability of existing experimental results that rely upon these games.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了慈善独裁者博弈（CDGs）与公共品博弈（PGGs）中慷慨行为之间的关系。我们构建了一个新颖的广义博弈，将两者作为特例包含在内，并向实验对象呈现CDG和PGG任务的不同组合。尽管对混淆因素进行了严密的实验控制，CDG和PGG中的慷慨行为仅呈弱相关。我们进一步展示了潜在偏好如何塑造这些行为，揭示了慈善偏好与公共品供给偏好之间的重要区别。我们的发现对依赖这些博弈的现有实验结果的可推广性具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Bribery and temptation: More red tape or more discretion?
articles.title_cn: 贿赂与诱惑：更多繁文缛节还是更多自由裁量权？
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies the moral dilemma of bribery in the presence of official discretion. The moral dilemma is framed as a dynamic choice problem in which an official’s present biased temptation preferences that value bribery conflict with commitment preferences that place more value on honesty. The tension between temptation and commitment becomes salient in the presence of the official’s discretionary power. More discretion allows the official to lower red-tape which is socially beneficial, but it also makes bribery more tempting thereby making commitment to honesty more costly. Accordingly, a morally committed bureaucrat may choose less discretion (which generates more red-tape) as a remedy to avoid being tempted by bribery. Whereas, the welfare maximizing policy will often impose high discretion, which generates psychic temptation costs on honest officials.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了在官员自由裁量权存在的情况下贿赂的道德困境。道德困境被构建为一个动态选择问题，其中官员的当前偏向诱惑偏好重视贿赂，与更重视诚实的承诺偏好相冲突。在官员拥有自由裁量权的情况下，诱惑与承诺之间的紧张关系变得突出。更多的自由裁量权允许官员减少繁文缛节，这对社会有益，但也使贿赂更具诱惑力，从而使对诚实的承诺成本更高。因此，一个有道德承诺的官僚可能会选择较少的自由裁量权（这会产生更多的繁文缛节）作为避免被贿赂诱惑的补救措施。而福利最大化的政策通常会施加高自由裁量权，这会给诚实的官员带来心理诱惑成本。

articles.title_en: To change or not to change? – Status quo bias and happiness
articles.title_cn: 改变还是不改变？——现状偏差与幸福感
articles.abstract_en: The status-quo bias (SQB) is the tendency to stick with the current situation despite potential dissatisfaction. In this study, we explore the relationship between SQB and subjective well-being (SWB). We hypothesized that higher SQB may lead to less desirable situations (e.g., unsatisfactory marriage, unwanted job), negatively affecting SWB. We developed and examined a novel index for measuring SQB. Surveying 1,423 Israeli working adults, the index showed strong internal consistency and validity, affirming reliability and construct validity. A significant negative correlation between SQB and three SWB measures was found, with SQB explaining more to SWB variations than subjective health, income, and religion combined. Positive life changes over the past three years have moderated this relationship. Moreover, despite including factors like regret, present bias, loss aversion, and optimism—which correlate with SWB and SQB in opposite directions and, therefore, could nullify our findings—the SQB-SWB correlation remained robust. Furthermore, our SQB measure significantly predicted SWB even when controlling for the negative relationship between the affective component of SWB (i.e., emotions) and SQB, which was demonstrated to operate in reverse causality compared to our hypothesis. In other words, SQB was found to mediate between the affective component and the other components of SWB. By providing evidence of the correlation between SQB and SWB, we introduce a robust SQB measurement tool, and underscore SQB's importance when exploring SWB determinants, suggesting that policy interventions encouraging individuals to overcome barriers to change could be advantageous.
articles.abstract_cn: 现状偏差（SQB）是指尽管可能不满意，仍倾向于维持现状的倾向。在本研究中，我们探讨了SQB与主观幸福感（SWB）之间的关系。我们假设较高的SQB可能导致不太理想的状况（例如，不满意的婚姻、不想要的工作），从而对SWB产生负面影响。我们开发并检验了一个衡量SQB的新指数。通过对1,423名以色列在职成年人的调查，该指数显示出较强的内部一致性和效度，证实了其信度和构念效度。研究发现SQB与三个SWB测量指标之间存在显著的负相关，且SQB对SWB变异的解释力大于主观健康、收入和宗教的总和。过去三年中的积极生活变化调节了这种关系。此外，尽管纳入了后悔、现时偏差、损失厌恶和乐观等因素——这些因素与SWB和SQB的相关方向相反，因此可能抵消我们的发现——SQB与SWB的相关性仍然稳健。此外，即使控制了SWB的情感成分（即情绪）与SQB之间的负向关系（该关系被证明与我们的假设相比存在反向因果关系），我们的SQB测量指标仍能显著预测SWB。换言之，发现SQB在情感成分与SWB的其他成分之间起中介作用。通过提供SQB与SWB相关性的证据，我们引入了一个稳健的SQB测量工具，并强调了SQB在探究SWB决定因素时的重要性，表明鼓励个体克服改变障碍的政策干预可能是有益的。

articles.title_en: Marry into new or old money? The distributional impact of marital decisions from an intergenerational perspective
articles.title_cn: 嫁入新贵还是旧贵？代际视角下婚姻决策的分配影响
articles.abstract_en: How sticky is wealth inequality across generations due to marital sorting? To analyze this question, we utilize a comprehensive Swiss dataset. Our findings highlight that marital sorting based on wealth is especially pronounced at the extremes of the wealth distribution, exacerbating wealth inequality. Simultaneously, we observe that the similarity in wealth between the parents of married partners is substantially less pronounced. Our findings suggest a more significant occurrence of marriages into ”new money” than ”old money”. Consequently, our study shows that parental wealth has a limited role in contributing to the inequality stemming from marital choices. We present evidence that intergenerational social mobility plays a pivotal role in counteracting the potential intensification of wealth structures due to marriage.
articles.abstract_cn: 财富不平等在代际间的粘性有多大，这归因于婚姻匹配？为分析这一问题，我们利用了瑞士的综合数据集。我们的发现强调，基于财富的婚姻匹配在财富分布的极端处尤为显著，加剧了财富不平等。同时，我们观察到已婚伴侣父母之间的财富相似性明显较弱。我们的发现表明，嫁入“新钱”比嫁入“旧钱”的发生更为显著。因此，我们的研究表明，父母财富在促成源于婚姻选择的平等方面作用有限。我们提供的证据表明，代际社会流动性在抵消婚姻可能导致的财富结构强化方面发挥着关键作用。

articles.title_en: Measuring transaction costs in China’s rural land rental market: Ex-ante bargaining associated with ex-post contract-violation uncertainty and location specificity
articles.title_cn: 中国农村土地流转市场中的交易成本测量：与事后违约不确定性和区位特定性相关的事前议价
articles.abstract_en: I measure the monetary value of ex-ante bargaining costs associated with China’s rural land rental market, confirming the previously unverified existence of transaction costs in this market. I demonstrate that the ex-ante bargaining costs associated with contractual formality represent the main transaction costs that hinder market progress. In a three-step theory, I model the process through which transaction costs are generated. First, uncertainty regarding ex-post contract violations caused by non-agricultural income shocks and location specificity in China’s fragmented farmland results in conflicting partner preferences. Second, the compromise mechanism that facilitates efficient bargaining makes the agent facing lower compromise costs in a transaction more likely to compromise. Third, ex-ante bargaining costs are generated in inefficient bargaining when theoretically predicted agents refuse to compromise. Using a subsample of data introduced in Yang (2020), I find that ex-ante bargaining costs are 126.5 RMB and 35.4 RMB per mu per year, respectively, for renting-out agents and renting-in agents who refuse to compromise in contract negotiations.
articles.abstract_cn: 我测量了中国农村土地流转市场中事前议价成本的货币价值，证实了该市场中此前未经验证的交易成本的存在。我证明，与合同形式性相关的事前议价成本是阻碍市场发展的主要交易成本。在一个三步理论中，我模拟了交易成本产生的过程。首先，由非农收入冲击和中国细碎化农田的区位特定性引起的事后合同违约的不确定性，导致合作伙伴偏好冲突。其次，促进有效议价的妥协机制使得在交易中面临较低妥协成本的代理人更可能妥协。第三，当理论上预测的代理人拒绝妥协时，低效议价中便产生了事前议价成本。利用Yang（2020）中引入的数据子样本，我发现，对于在合同谈判中拒绝妥协的出租方和承租方代理人，事前议价成本分别为每mu每年126.5元人民币和35.4元人民币。

articles.title_en: Deductibles and health care utilization: An experiment on the role of forward-looking behavior
articles.title_cn: 免赔额与医疗利用：关于前瞻性行为作用的实验研究
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the effects of nonlinear deductible contracts on health utilization behavior by using a laboratory experiment in which we can control the likelihood of hitting the deductible. We also evaluate the effect of subjects receiving regular information updates on their remaining deductible. Our results show that varying the future price has a significant effect on health care consumption. At an individual level, we identify and richly characterize heterogeneity. We find fully forward-looking, fully myopic, as well as mixed types after controlling for risk preferences. We show that there is a substantial welfare loss due to a lack in forward-looking behavior. The distribution of the welfare loss are characterized and differ sharply according to the model of risk preferences adopted for normative evaluation. Potential drivers of welfare effects are investigated and have a tendency to differ across risk preference models.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过实验室实验研究非线性免赔额合同对医疗利用行为的影响，在该实验中我们可以控制达到免赔额的可能性。我们还评估了受试者定期收到剩余免赔额信息更新的效果。我们的结果表明，改变未来价格对医疗消费有显著影响。在个体层面，我们识别并详细描述了异质性。在控制风险偏好后，我们发现完全前瞻型、完全短视型以及混合型。我们表明，由于缺乏前瞻性行为，存在显著的福利损失。福利损失的分布被刻画，并且根据规范评估所采用的风险偏好模型而显著不同。我们调查了福利效应的潜在驱动因素，这些因素往往因风险偏好模型而异。

articles.title_en: The Kőszegi–Rabin expectations-based model and risk-apportionment tasks for elicitation of higher order risk preferences
articles.title_cn: Kőszegi–Rabin期望参考点模型与高阶风险偏好诱导的风险分配任务
articles.abstract_en: This paper examines the predictions of expectations-based reference-dependent models for risk-apportionment tasks that elicit higher-order risk attitudes. We consider some of the most commonly used specifications of Kőszegi and Rabin (2006, 2007) and disappointment aversion models. Our analysis reveals that higher order risky choices exhibited by decision makers defined by those model specifications depend on whether risks to be apportioned in these tasks are symmetric or asymmetric, whether they include small probability outcomes, and on the level of loss aversion. We highlight that some of the predicted choice behaviour in the risk-apportionment tasks differs from the ones in alternative models of decision under risk. We employ experimental data to examine whether choice patterns in the risk apportionment tasks are in line with the predictions of the model specifications described here. We find that only a small proportion of them are consistent with those predictions.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文考察了基于期望的参考依赖模型在诱导高阶风险态度的风险分配任务中的预测。我们考虑了Kőszegi和Rabin（2006，2007）以及失望厌恶模型的一些最常用设定。我们的分析表明，由这些模型设定所定义的决策者在高阶风险选择中的表现取决于这些任务中待分配的风险是对称的还是不对称的，是否包含小概率结果，以及损失厌恶的水平。我们强调，风险分配任务中预测的某些选择行为与风险决策的替代模型中的行为不同。我们利用实验数据来检验风险分配任务中的选择模式是否与本文所述模型设定的预测一致。我们发现，其中只有一小部分与这些预测一致。

articles.title_en: And suddenly, the rain! When surprises shape experienced utility
articles.title_cn: 突然下雨！当惊喜塑造体验效用
articles.abstract_en: This study examines how unexpected exogenous events, labelled as suprises, affect the utility of experience goods reported in online rating systems. Using over 300,000 reviews of accommodation services listed on Booking.com, the research investigates whether online ratings capture the impact of surprises related to meteorological conditions and whether they create additional biases in service evaluation. The study finds that sudden changes in weather conditions have a significant impact on experienced utility, with the effect varying based on the direction of the surprise. Additionally, in line with the hedonic adaption theory, we find that the duration of consumption moderates the surprise effect, reducing its impact on reported utility.
articles.abstract_cn: 本研究探讨了意外外生事件（称为惊喜）如何影响在线评分系统中报告的体验商品效用。利用Booking.com上列出的住宿服务的超过300,000条评论，研究调查了在线评分是否捕捉到与气象条件相关的惊喜的影响，以及这些惊喜是否在服务评估中造成额外偏差。研究发现，天气状况的突然变化对体验效用有显著影响，且该效应因惊喜的方向而异。此外，与享乐适应理论一致，我们发现消费持续时间调节了惊喜效应，减少了其对报告效用的影响。

articles.title_en: “Friends Are Thieves of Time”: Heuristic attention sharing in stable friendship networks
articles.title_cn: “朋友是时间的窃贼”：稳定友谊网络中的启发式注意力共享
articles.abstract_en: This paper studies a model of network formation in which agents create links following a simple heuristic — they invest their limited resources proportionally more in neighbours who have fewer links. This decision rule captures the notion that when considering social value more connected agents are on average less beneficial as neighbours and node degree is a useful proxy when payoffs are difficult to compute. The decision rule illustrates an externalities effect whereby an agent’s actions also influence his neighbours’ neighbours. Besides complete networks and fragmented networks with complete components, the pairwise stable networks produced by this model include many non-standard ones with characteristics observed in real life networks like clustering and irregular components. Multiple stable states can develop from the same initial structure — the stable networks could have cliques linked by intermediary agents while sometimes they have a core–periphery structure. The observed pairwise stable networks have close to optimal welfare. This limited loss of welfare is due to the fact that when a link is established, this is beneficial to the linking agents, but makes them less attractive as neighbours for others, thereby partially internalising the externalities the new connection has generated.
articles.abstract_cn: 本文研究了一个网络形成模型，其中代理人遵循一个简单的启发式规则来建立联系——他们将有限的资源不成比例地更多地投资于联系较少的邻居。这一决策规则捕捉了这样一种观念：在考虑社会价值时，联系更紧密的代理人平均而言作为邻居的益处较小，而当收益难以计算时，节点度是一个有用的代理指标。该决策规则展示了一种外部性效应，即代理人的行为也会影响其邻居的邻居。除了完全网络和具有完全组成部分的碎片化网络外，该模型产生的成对稳定网络还包括许多非标准网络，这些网络具有现实生活网络中观察到的特征，如聚类和不规则组成部分。从相同的初始结构可以发展出多个稳定状态——稳定网络可能由中间代理人连接的派系组成，有时它们具有核心-边缘结构。观察到的成对稳定网络具有接近最优的福利。这种有限的福利损失是由于当建立联系时，这对建立联系的代理人有利，但使他们作为其他人的邻居的吸引力降低，从而部分内化了新联系产生的外部性。

articles.title_en: Early climate mitigation as a social dilemma
articles.title_cn: 早期气候减缓作为社会困境
articles.abstract_en: We introduce a novel game where a decaying atmospheric quality, modeled as a stock variable determining the payoff externality, can be counteracted through individual mitigation efforts. It encompasses three characteristics of climate change as a social dilemma: (a) the continuous nature of climate degradation, (b) the constant influx of emissions resulting from human economic activities, and (c) the greater efficacy of early mitigation actions. We report findings from an experiment where, across four treatments, we manipulate the starting atmospheric quality and introduce inequality in the endowments employed to mitigate. Results indicate that subjects fail to mitigate in early periods, an individually rational strategy. We do not find differences between treatments at the aggregate level. However, participants treat their groupmates’ past mitigation as a strategic substitute for their own mitigation (i.e., if others’ mitigation increase, participants reduce their mitigation). This substitution is less intense if the initial atmospheric quality is negative.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们引入了一种新颖的博弈，其中大气质量的退化被建模为决定收益外部性的存量变量，可以通过个体的减缓努力来抵消。它包含了气候变化作为社会困境的三个特征：（a）气候退化的连续性，（b）人类经济活动导致的持续排放流入，以及（c）早期减缓行动的更大效力。我们报告了一项实验的结果，在四种处理中，我们操纵了初始大气质量，并引入了用于减缓的禀赋不平等。结果表明，受试者在早期阶段未能减缓，这是一个个体理性的策略。我们在总体水平上没有发现处理之间的差异。然而，参与者将同伴过去的减缓视为自身减缓的战略替代品（即，如果他人的减缓增加，参与者会减少自身的减缓）。如果初始大气质量为负，这种替代效应较弱。

articles.title_en: An experimental test of gaming incentives
articles.title_cn: 游戏化激励的实验检验
articles.abstract_en: In recent years, many organizations have undertaken efforts to introduce gaming incentives in order to enhance employee effort and user engagement. However, these incentives are not well understood, and subsequently there is a dearth of systematically controlled empirical evidence on their effects, as well as their interaction with other forms of motivation. We present the first comprehensive test of gaming incentives using a real effort lab experiment with a standard lab task adapted to allow the inclusion of gaming incentives. We test the effect of these incentives under two types of extrinsic incentives, an unconditional wage, and a piece rate. In addition, we also measure subject task motivation and explore interaction with intrinsic (task based) incentives. We report three main findings: first, gaming incentives increase effort when extrinsic incentives to exert effort are weak. When extrinsic incentives are strong, gaming incentives have no additional impact on effort, showcasing diminishing returns to multiple forms of incentives. Finally, some forms of gaming incentives are successful in increasing effort among the least task motivated, a property that is similar to extrinsic incentives. Implications for organizations seeking to implement gaming incentives are discussed.
articles.abstract_cn: 近年来，许多组织努力引入游戏化激励，以提升员工努力和用户参与度。然而，这些激励措施尚未被充分理解，因此关于其效果及其与其他形式动机的相互作用，缺乏系统控制的实证证据。我们通过一项真实努力实验室实验，首次对游戏化激励进行了全面检验，该实验采用标准实验室任务并加以调整以纳入游戏化激励。我们在两种外在激励类型下测试了这些激励的效果：无条件工资和计件工资。此外，我们还测量了受试者的任务动机，并探讨了与内在（基于任务的）激励的相互作用。我们报告了三个主要发现：首先，当外在激励较弱时，游戏化激励会增加努力；当外在激励较强时，游戏化激励对努力没有额外影响，显示出多种激励形式的边际收益递减。最后，某些形式的游戏化激励能够成功增加任务动机最低者的努力，这一特性类似于外在激励。本文讨论了寻求实施游戏化激励的组织所面临的启示。

articles.title_en: Unsafe temperatures, unsafe jobs: The impact of weather conditions on work-related injuries
articles.title_cn: 不安全的温度，不安全的工作：天气条件对工伤的影响
articles.abstract_en: We estimate the impact of temperatures on work-related accident rates in Italy by using daily data on weather conditions matched to administrative daily data on work-related accidents. The identification strategy of the causal effect relies on the plausible exogeneity of short-term daily temperature variations in a given spatial unit. We find that both high and cold temperatures impair occupational health by increasing workplace injury rates. The positive effect of warmer weather conditions on work-related accident rates is larger for men and for workplace injuries. Older workers and jobs in the service sector are instead affected less. Colder temperatures lead to a substantial increase in commuting accidents, especially on rainy days.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们利用意大利的每日天气数据与行政记录的每日工伤数据相匹配，估计了温度对工伤事故率的影响。因果效应的识别策略依赖于给定空间单元内短期日温度变化的合理外生性。我们发现，高温和低温都会通过增加工作场所事故率来损害职业健康。较暖天气条件对工伤事故率的正向影响在男性和工作场所伤害中更大。老年工人和服务业的工作则受影响较小。较低温度导致通勤事故大幅增加，尤其是在雨天。

articles.title_en: Does correlation matter in probability matching? A laboratory investigation
articles.title_cn: 相关性在概率匹配中重要吗？一项实验室研究
articles.abstract_en: Probability Matching, a classical violation of expected utility maximization, refers to people's tendency to randomize, or even match their choice frequency to the outcome probability, when choosing over binary lotteries that differ only in their probabilities. Why? I present an experiment designed to distinguish between several broad classes of explanations: (1) models of Correlation-Invariant Stochastic Choice — randomizing due to factors orthogonal to the correlation between lotteries, such as non-standard preferences or errors, and (2) models of Correlation-Sensitive Stochastic Choice — deliberately randomizing due to misperceived hedging opportunities, especially when lotteries are negatively correlated. My experimental design differentiates between their testable predictions by varying the correlation between lottery outcomes. The findings indicate that the first class, despite being home to most existing theories, has limited explanatory power. Using additional treatment, I rule out Similarity Heuristics as a competing explanation with the second class. The results indicate that a vast majority of individuals deliberately randomize due to misperceived hedging opportunities.
articles.abstract_cn: 概率匹配是对期望效用最大化的一种经典违背，指的是当人们在仅概率不同的二元彩票之间进行选择时，倾向于随机化，甚至使自己的选择频率与结果概率相匹配。为什么？我提出了一项实验，旨在区分几大类解释：（1）相关性不变随机选择模型——由于与彩票之间相关性正交的因素（如非标准偏好或错误）而随机化，以及（2）相关性敏感随机选择模型——由于错误感知的对冲机会而故意随机化，尤其是在彩票负相关时。我的实验设计通过改变彩票结果之间的相关性来区分它们的可检验预测。研究结果表明，第一类尽管容纳了大多数现有理论，但其解释力有限。通过额外的处理，我排除了相似性启发式作为第二类的竞争性解释。结果表明，绝大多数个体是由于错误感知的对冲机会而故意随机化。

articles.title_en: Conspicuous consumption: Vehicle purchases by non-prime consumers
articles.title_cn: 炫耀性消费：非优质消费者的车辆购买行为
articles.abstract_en: Lower-income consumers who seek to increase their perceived social status or to emulate their wealthier peers may be motivated to purchase conspicuous luxury goods. Using a vehicle financing dataset, we find that non-prime consumers value vehicle prestige more than the average consumer. The stronger preferences for prestige lead non-prime consumers to purchase more expensive vehicles than they otherwise would. The preferences for prestige are driven both by status signaling and peer emulation motives. Furthermore, we show that larger vehicle purchases financed by auto loans lead to worse loan performance and credit standing for non-prime consumers.
articles.abstract_cn: 低收入消费者若寻求提升其感知社会地位或模仿更富裕的同龄人，可能被激励购买炫耀性奢侈品。利用车辆融资数据集，我们发现非优质消费者比普通消费者更看重车辆声望。对声望的更强偏好导致非优质消费者购买比他们原本会购买的更昂贵的车辆。对声望的偏好既受地位信号动机驱动，也受同伴模仿动机驱动。此外，我们表明，由汽车贷款融资的更大车辆购买会导致非优质消费者贷款表现和信用状况恶化。

articles.title_en: Consumption dynamics with law of small numbers
articles.title_cn: 小数定律下的消费动态
articles.abstract_en: We propose an intertemporal consumption-saving model by exploring the implications of the Law of Small Numbers (LSN), a belief heuristic stating that any sample realization of a population should be representative of the population. First, the existence of the LSN reduces the precautionary savings demand. More importantly, we show that the LSN belief structure provides an alternative explanation for two fundamental anomalies in consumption theory: (1) excess sensitivity by showing that past changes in income predict future changes in consumption; and (2) excess smoothness by lowering consumption volatility and generating the empirical magnitude.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们通过探讨小数定律（LSN）的含义，提出一个跨期消费-储蓄模型，该定律是一种信念启发式，认为总体的任何样本实现都应代表总体。首先，LSN的存在降低了预防性储蓄需求。更重要的是，我们表明LSN信念结构为消费理论中的两个基本异常提供了另一种解释：（1）过度敏感性，通过表明过去的收入变化预测未来的消费变化；以及（2）过度平滑性，通过降低消费波动性并产生经验幅度。

articles.title_en: Team size and diversity
articles.title_cn: 团队规模与多样性
articles.abstract_en: We analyze the relationship between performance, team diversity and size. We first propose a model with knowledge spillovers in production, which predicts that the effect of a diverse team member – relative to the impact of a non-diverse team member – increases with team size. We experimentally test the model by randomly assigning students to solve knowledge questions in teams of different sizes, with or without a person with a diverse knowledge set. In line with the model, we find that the benefit of having a diverse rather than a same-skill colleague is greater in larger relative to small teams. These results have implications for how organizations can design their teams to maximize knowledge flows and performance.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们分析了绩效、团队多样性和规模之间的关系。我们首先提出了一个具有知识溢出效应的生产模型，该模型预测，相对于非多样化团队成员的影响，多样化团队成员的影响随团队规模的增大而增强。我们通过随机分配学生以不同规模的团队解决知识问题（无论是否包含具有多样化知识背景的成员）来实验检验该模型。与模型一致，我们发现，在较大团队中，拥有多样化而非同技能同事的益处大于较小团队。这些结果对组织如何设计团队以最大化知识流动和绩效具有启示意义。

articles.title_en: Corporate social responsibility and bargaining in unionized markets
articles.title_cn: 企业社会责任与工会化市场中的谈判
articles.abstract_en: We investigate the firms’ and unions’ incentives to engage in socially responsibility activities in a unionized differentiated goods’ duopoly market. The socially responsible attributes attached to products are considered as credence goods, with consumers forming expectations about their existence and level. We show that a Corporate Social Responsibility (CSR) bargaining scheme, in which firms and unions bargain over not only the wage rate but also the level of the firms’ CSR activities, always arises in equilibrium. Incorporating CSR activities into the union–firm bargaining agenda acts as a commitment device that credibly signals to consumers the level of CSR activities undertaken by firms. The market equilibrium leads to the highest social welfare; thus, market and societal incentives are aligned.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们研究了在工会化的差异化商品双头垄断市场中，企业和工会参与社会责任活动的激励。产品附带的社会责任属性被视为信用品，消费者对其存在和水平形成预期。我们表明，企业社会责任（CSR）谈判方案——即企业和工会不仅就工资率进行谈判，还就企业CSR活动的水平进行谈判——总是在均衡中出现。将CSR活动纳入工会-企业谈判议程，作为一种承诺机制，向消费者可信地传递企业所进行的CSR活动水平。市场均衡导致最高的社会福利；因此，市场和社会激励是一致的。

articles.title_en: The wisdom of the madness of crowds: Investor herding, anti-herding, and stock-bond return correlation
articles.title_cn: 群体疯狂中的智慧：投资者羊群行为、反羊群行为与股票-债券收益相关性
articles.abstract_en: We examine investors’ herding/anti-herding behavior in the US stock and corporate bond markets and their impact on stock-bond return correlation. Corporate bonds exhibit herding, with stocks displaying anti-herding. Bond herding and stock anti-herding are weakly related, with each significantly dampening the stock-bond return correlation. This effect is largely driven by their irrational components, affecting mostly the correlation of noise-driven stock and bond return elements, more so during periods of elevated uncertainty, optimistic sentiment and excessively positive economic performance. As the irrational forces in each asset class (stocks; bonds) countervail each other, this implies greater stability and resilience for the financial system.
articles.abstract_cn: 我们考察了美国股票和公司债券市场中投资者的羊群行为/反羊群行为及其对股票-债券收益相关性的影响。公司债券表现出羊群行为，而股票则表现出反羊群行为。债券羊群行为与股票反羊群行为之间关联较弱，但各自均显著降低了股票-债券收益相关性。这一效应主要由其非理性成分驱动，主要影响噪声驱动的股票和债券收益要素之间的相关性，在不确定性升高、乐观情绪和过度积极的经济表现时期更为显著。由于每类资产（股票；债券）中的非理性力量相互抵消，这意味着金融体系具有更高的稳定性和韧性。

articles.title_en: Ethnic bias, economic achievement and trust between large ethnic groups: A study in Germany and the U.S
articles.title_cn: 族群偏见、经济成就与大型族群间的信任：德国与美国的研究
articles.abstract_en: Evidence for ingroup bias is extensive, yet the distinct patterns of discrimination among dominant ethnic groups in the diverse societies of modern industrial nations such as the United States and Germany remain largely unexplored. Incentivized trust games in nationally-representative samples from both countries reveal biases of roughly equal size by non-Hispanic White Americans, Hispanic Americans, and African Americans against each outgroup. In Germany, the majority demonstrates twice as much bias against Turkish minorities compared to Eastern Europeans. Interestingly, both minority groups send similar amounts to ethnic Germans and members of their own groups. We examine the notion that outgroup discrimination by majority group members stems from stereotypes of minorities as economically unsuccessful, employing trust games with high-income counterparts. We find that majority senders’ bias against minority receivers declines when receivers are known to have high incomes, in line with that idea. Interestingly, some minority groups, especially Turkish descendants, display a negative propensity to transfer to rich members of their ingroup in comparison with outgroup members, relative to baseline. While we focus on differences in sending by ethnic pairing, we note that all participants send less to second movers identified as high income, and discuss possible explanations. We estimate that four-fifths of the observed ingroup bias is taste-based rather than due to expected trustworthiness differences. This estimation is robust to identifying the purely altruistic component of trust game sending toward each ethnic group, including one's own.
articles.abstract_cn: 内群体偏见的证据广泛存在，但在现代工业国家如美国和德国的多元社会中，主导族群之间歧视的不同模式在很大程度上仍未得到探索。来自两国全国代表性样本的激励性信任博弈显示，非西班牙裔白人美国人、西班牙裔美国人和非裔美国人对每个外群体的偏见规模大致相同。在德国，多数群体对土耳其少数群体的偏见是对东欧人的两倍。有趣的是，两个少数群体向德国族裔和本群体成员发送的金额相似。我们检验了多数群体成员对外群体的歧视源于对少数群体经济不成功的刻板印象这一观点，采用与高收入对应方进行的信任博弈。我们发现，当接收者已知具有高收入时，多数群体发送者对外群体接收者的偏见下降，这与该观点一致。有趣的是，一些少数群体，尤其是土耳其后裔，在基线水平上相对于外群体成员，表现出向本群体富裕成员转移的负面倾向。虽然我们关注的是按族群配对发送的差异，但我们注意到所有参与者向被识别为高收入的第二行动者发送的金额较少，并讨论了可能的解释。我们估计，观察到的内群体偏见中五分之四是基于品味而非预期的可信度差异。这一估计对于识别信任博弈中向每个族群（包括本族群）发送的纯粹利他成分是稳健的。

articles.title_en: Identity and access: Gender-based preferences and physician availability in primary care
articles.title_cn: 身份与获取：初级保健中的性别偏好与医生可用性
articles.abstract_en: Patient preferences for physicians may be influenced by shared characteristics such as gender. We analyzed experimental data from a survey of US adults in which respondents were asked to choose between physician profiles that on average varied only by gender. We find that female patients prefer female physicians to male physicians by 51.8 percentage points (95 % CI: 0.470 to 0.566, p < 0.01), and that result holds across Black, White, and Hispanic sub-groups. With no countervailing preference among male patients, this result holds in the overall sample at 26.8 percentage points (95 % CI: 0.228 to 0.307, p < 0.01). We also analyzed data from a simulated patient field experiment concerning access to primary care appointments and find that female physicians, on average, offer appointments 7.1 days later than male physicians (95 % CI: 5.1 to 9.1, p < 0.01), consistent with the finding that female physicians are preferred. Female physicians’ offices appear to favor female patients, offering appointments to them 2.6 days earlier compared to male patients (95 % CI: -5.3 to 0.195, p = 0.07). However, Hispanic female patients were offered 4.2-percentage-points fewer appointments compared to Hispanic males (95 % CI: -0.069 to -0.014, p < 0.01) by female physicians’ offices. Similarly, Black female patients were told that the physician is “not taking new patients” 3.5 percentage points more often (95 % CI: -0.004 to 0.073, p = 0.08) and were offered appointments that were 2.6 minutes shorter compared to Black males (95 % CI: -4.8 to -0.44, p = 0.02). Overall, our analysis suggests that female primary care physicians are in high demand relative to their supply, and that access to scarce female physicians is mediated by race and ethnicity.
articles.abstract_cn: 患者对医生的偏好可能受到性别等共同特征的影响。我们分析了一项针对美国成年人的调查中的实验数据，受访者被要求在平均仅因性别而异的医生档案之间进行选择。我们发现，女性患者偏好女性医生而非男性医生的比例为51.8个百分点（95%置信区间：0.470至0.566，p<0.01），且该结果在黑人、白人和西班牙裔亚组中均成立。由于男性患者没有相反的偏好，该结果在总体样本中为26.8个百分点（95%置信区间：0.228至0.307，p<0.01）。我们还分析了模拟患者实地实验中关于初级保健预约获取的数据，发现女性医生平均提供预约的时间比男性医生晚7.1天（95%置信区间：5.1至9.1，p<0.01），这与女性医生更受偏好的发现一致。女性医生的诊所似乎偏爱女性患者，为她们提供的预约比男性患者早2.6天（95%置信区间：-5.3至0.195，p=0.07）。然而，西班牙裔女性患者被女性医生诊所提供的预约比西班牙裔男性少4.2个百分点（95%置信区间：-0.069至-0.014，p<0.01）。同样，黑人女性患者被告知医生“不接受新患者”的频率比黑人男性高3.5个百分点（95%置信区间：-0.004至0.073，p=0.08），并且获得的预约时长比黑人男性短2.6分钟（95%置信区间：-4.8至-0.44，p=0.02）。总体而言，我们的分析表明，女性初级保健医生的需求相对于供给较高，而获取稀缺女性医生的机会受到种族和族裔的调节。
